about: Competitor homepages for tools/bench_compare.js (--group right, brands or all). Each URL was fetched on Nov 9, 2026 with curl, following redirects, and is the address it settled on; the page title confirmed it is the organization's own site. Add a group by adding another array of {name, url, note}.

right.name: Young Republican National Federation
right.note: yri.org is a GoDaddy domain-for-sale page, so the federation's own site is used. It showed a 'Checking your browser' page to headless Chromium in the Nov 9 research run (docs/research/07-benchmark-right-wing.md).

right.name: College Republicans of America
right.note: The CRNC's rival national College Republicans organization (see docs/research/07-benchmark-right-wing.md).

brands.name: poppi
brands.note: poppi.com redirects to a domain-for-sale page (domains.atom.com); the brand's site is drinkpoppi.com.
